profile.campus: True North Data campus, Loudoun County, VA (Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, PIN 194103673000, approved Jan 2018)
profile.reading: This building sits at 42255 Thunderball Drive in Leesburg, Virginia, part of a data center campus that Loudoun County own zoning and permitting records identify by the project name True North Data. Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, filed under that project name, rezoned roughly 105 acres to Planned Development-Office Park specifically to allow data center uses, and was approved January 18, 2018. The underlying parcel, county PIN 194103673000, covering roughly 97 acres, is recorded under a condominium-regime plat named True North Land Condo, a legal structure commonly used to subdivide one large hyperscale campus parcel into separately titled buildings, consistent with the six separate addresses and building records that make up this cluster. A 2019 grading permit for a project called True North 2 described three data center buildings with utilities, and a 2023 stormwater permit for True North Data Phase 2A covered a further 16.5 acres of disturbed area, indicating a phased expansion. Four tenant fit-up zoning permits were issued across April and May 2025, suggesting the campus was still being built out in phases as recently as that year. No document reviewed this session, however, gives a total megawatt capacity, final building count, or total square footage for the completed campus, and the identity of the corporate entity that actually filed the original 2017 rezoning application is not exposed in the county public zoning-case layer, so True North Data Solutions, the name this record carries as operator, could not be independently confirmed as a registered company through the Virginia State Corporation Commission this session. Loudoun County is widely described as the largest data center market in the world by capacity, and Leesburg location within it, near the eastern edge of the county fiber and power-dense corridor, is consistent with why a developer would pursue a multi-building campus of this scale here specifically.

reading.body:
This facility at 42255 Thunderball Dr in Leesburg, Virginia has no published capacity figure, so its scale relative to Virginia's AI infrastructure cannot be determined from operator specifications. The operator, True North Data Solutions, maintains no reachable corporate website and does not appear in secondary sources, making independent verification of the site's specifications impossible at this time.

Virginia hosts 326 mapped data center facilities, of which only 23 have published megawatt figures totaling 1,375 MW. This Leesburg site ranks 24th among Virginia facilities by published capacity, a ranking that reflects only the 23 facilities with disclosed power—meaning it either publishes no figure or publishes less than the smallest disclosed capacity in the state. The vast majority of Virginia's mapped infrastructure, like this campus, operates without public specification.

Without published power capacity, cooling capacity, or facility size, this site cannot be assessed as material to AI scaling decisions. It may host significant load or negligible load. Only if the operator publishes specifications, or independent reporting surfaces them, can this location be read as a meaningful point in the grid constraint on AI compute.
